Descriptions

Our elegant white glass cabinet with tea-colored glass doors is a timeless piece of furniture that perfectly combines elegance and functionality. With its generous dimensions of 70*35*150cm, this cabinet offers enough space for displaying and storing your favorite pieces. Behind the 2 tea-colored glass doors are 3 levels with variable shelves, one of which is fixed and the other two are movable. This allows the storage space to be flexibly adapted to your individual needs. Additionally, the cabinet offers 2 large drawers with an elegant vertical stripe design on the surface, which ensures a smooth and clean surface without annoying edges through suction technology. The robust golden legs of the cabinet not only give it a noble look, but also provide stability. The floor protection pads on the legs protect your floor from scratches and ensure a secure stand. The integrated 16-colour LED lighting behind the glass doors skilfully sets the scene for your exhibits and creates an inviting atmosphere. Thanks to the well-thought-out cable management openings on the back of the cabinet, you can lay your cables neatly and safely. This ensures a clean and tidy look in the room. Perfect for use in the living room, dining room, or office, this glass cabinet adds an elegant touch to any room.
